within_event: mean of defined repetition ratios; retain all three and disclose NA/failure slots

bootstrap.stratification: resample the same number of events within each supplied predeclared scenario stratum; missing stratum is an error when stratification is requested
bootstrap.paired_contrasts: B1-B2, B2-B3, B3-B4 use identical resampled paired events
bootstrap.singleton_stratum: retained once per bootstrap sample; contributes no within-stratum resampling variation; disclose singleton counts

scenario_assignment: custodian supplies versioned event-to-scenario map before results inspection; never inferred from performance or exposed to generation
CI_scope: conditional on evaluated Sherlock events/scenarios, not real-world OT deployments
B0_micro_counts: Count the one deterministic artifact once per event; aligned repetition slots must have identical results and do not triple B0 micro denominators.
